text: Drake Maye's masterclass against Buffalo—capped by a three-touchdown performance that earned him AFC Offensive Player of the Week honors—has the Patriots breathing considerably easier after their 29-26 victory over the Bills and their dramatic climb back to 2-2 alongside fellow Week 4 comeback artists Dallas and Los Angeles. This Sunday at Gillette Stadium, the Patriots will look to build on that momentum against the Las Vegas Raiders while honoring legendary kicker Adam Vinatieri's Pro Football Hall of Fame induction during halftime, though defensive coordinator challenges loom large with the Raiders' formidable tight end tandem of Brock Bowers and Michael Mayer presenting a far different test than the effectively neutralized Dalton Kincaid proved to be last week. The roster is quietly shifting too, with the Patriots releasing LB Jose Ramirez while adding rookie CB Al'Zillion Hamilton to the practice squad and moving on from OL Da'Metrius Weatherspoon.
